name: Queen
movement: Moves and captures any distance orthogonally or diagonally.
flavor: The measure every other legend is judged against.

name: Archbishop
movement: Moves and captures one square diagonally.
ability: Every diagonally adjacent friendly piece may also move and capture like a Bishop.
flavor: His blessing runs along the diagonals.

name: Avenger
movement: Moves and captures like every friendly piece lost this game.
ability: Starts unable to move. Each friendly piece captured permanently adds that piece’s movement.
flavor: I become whatever my army has lost.

name: Champion
movement: Moves and captures like a Rook.
ability: Survives the first capture attempt against it and destroys the attacking piece instead.
flavor: The first blow only makes the armor stronger.

name: Chariot
movement: Moves and captures like a Rook.
ability: When it moves, you may return one of your captured Pawns to the square it left.
flavor: It advances, and brings the fallen back with it.

name: Diplomat
movement: Jumps exactly two squares orthogonally or diagonally, over whatever stands between.
ability: Any enemy piece jumped over changes allegiance. Kings are immune.

name: Duelist
movement: Moves and captures like a King.
ability: After your main move, the Duelist may take one free move.

name: General
movement: Moves and captures like a King.
ability: While the General is on the board, every friendly piece may also move (but not capture) like a King.

name: Infiltrator
movement: Moves and captures like a Rook or a King.
ability: Slides straight through friendly pieces. Enemy pieces still block it.
flavor: Walls and allies don't stop me.

name: Revolutionary
movement: Moves and captures like a Knight.
ability: On reaching the opponent's back row it may sacrifice itself: both players then swap armies.
flavor: Every throne is only ever borrowed.

name: Trapper
movement: Moves like a Queen. Cannot capture.
ability: Adjacent enemy pieces (orthogonally or diagonally) cannot move or capture. Enemy Trappers are unaffected.
flavor: Get near me and you are already caught.

name: Warrior
movement: Moves and captures like a Queen or a Knight.
ability: Cannot move on two of your turns in a row.
flavor: I can fight almost anywhere — but not endlessly.
